title: API Rate Limit Increase
old_behavior: Each API key is limited to 100 requests per minute across all endpoints, on all plans.
new_behavior: Each API key is limited to 500 requests per minute across all endpoints, on all plans.
description: Raising the default per-key throughput ceiling to support higher-volume integrations without requiring an Enterprise exception request.

title: "Export" Renamed to "Download"
old_behavior: The action to save data locally is labeled 'Export' throughout the app, including the toolbar button, menu items, and the icon used for one-off and scheduled report generation.
new_behavior: The action is relabeled 'Download' throughout the app (button text, menu items, icon tooltip). Underlying functionality, file formats, and API field names are unchanged.
description: Renaming based on user research showing 'Export' was confused with data migration; this is a label change only.

title: Starter Plan Storage Limit Increase
old_behavior: The Starter plan includes 5GB of cloud storage per team, covering uploads, exports, and attachments.
new_behavior: The Starter plan includes 20GB of cloud storage per team.
description: Quadrupling the Starter storage allowance to reduce upgrade pressure on small teams; Pro and Enterprise allowances are unchanged.

title: Legacy Webhook v1 Retirement
old_behavior: Webhook v1 endpoints (unsigned XML payloads, no retry metadata) remain active and continue delivering events alongside v2.
new_behavior: Webhook v1 endpoints are fully retired and stop delivering events. All integrations must use v2 (signed JSON payloads with X-Cascade-Signature header).
description: Sunsetting the original webhook delivery system; integrations still pointed at v1 endpoints must migrate before the cutover date or they will stop receiving events.

title: Password Reset Link Expiration Shortened
old_behavior: Password reset links remain valid for 24 hours after being sent.
new_behavior: Password reset links expire 1 hour after being sent.
description: Shortening the reset link lifetime to reduce the window in which an intercepted or stale link could be exploited.

title: Editor Role Split into Editor and Contributor
old_behavior: The 'Editor' role is a single, all-or-nothing grant: it allows creating, editing, and deleting any content in the workspace.
new_behavior: The 'Editor' role retains full create/edit/delete/publish rights. A new 'Contributor' role is introduced with create/edit rights only (no delete, no publish). Existing members with the Editor role keep it; new invites default to Contributor unless Editor is explicitly chosen.
description: Splitting the role so admins can grant content-creation access without also granting delete/publish rights, addressing repeated Enterprise customer requests.
